data.name: Lu'luah
data.gender_notes: Lu'luah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lu'luah is derived from the Arabic word 'lu'lu', which means jasmine. Lu'luah is a beautiful and feminine name that evokes images of flowers, gardens, and the sweet scent of jasmine. It is a name that embodies love, beauty, and the delicate nature of flowers. The name Lu'luah carries the meaning “Garland of Jasmine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lu'luah usually hope their child will grow to embody garland of jasmine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lu'luah is a name that carries spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is said that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) described paradise as a place where there are rivers of honey and milk, and where the people wear garlands of jasmine. Lu'luah is a reminder of the beauty and joy that await us in the hereafter.
data.etymology: Lu'luah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garland of Jasmine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lu'luah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: لؤلؤة
in_arabic.long_meaning: لؤلؤة هي اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من اللؤلؤ الذي يعني الجميلة كاللؤلؤة، و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الجمال و النقاء و الرفعة، و اللؤلؤ يعتبر من أرقى و أجمل الأحجار الكريمة، و هو رمز للثروة و الجمال.

in_urdu.name: لؤلؤہ
in_urdu.meaning: لؤلؤہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت لڑکی
in_urdu.long_meaning: لؤلؤہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو لؤلؤ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ایک خوبصورت اور قیمتی چیز، جیسے کہ لؤلؤ ایک قیمتی حجر ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی، پاکیزگی اور رفعت کی علامت ہے، اور یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے.

in_hindi.name: लू'लूअ

in_pashto.name: لؤلؤه
